# Protected billing & payment surface — machine-readable path list.
#
# Consumed by .github/workflows/protected-billing-surface.yml. Any pull
# request that changes a file matching one of the patterns below MUST carry
# the billing-surface declaration in its PR body (see the workflow and the
# PR template). This file also documents, for humans and agents, exactly
# which paths are high-risk.
#
# Format:
#   - one glob pattern per line (fnmatch-style; "*" and "**" match path
#     segments, "**" spans directories)
#   - blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored
#
# Scope discipline: this protects ONLY the high-risk billing surface, never
# the whole repository. General UI pages that merely render a billing CTA
# (e.g. PricingPage / UpgradeModal / CreditsPage) are intentionally NOT
# listed — only the dedicated billing modules are.
#
# NEVER put a secret value in this file. It contains path patterns only.

# ── Billing service core: provider selection, event vocabulary, config,
#    idempotency inbox, webhook signature verification, raw stores, portal,
#    readiness. The entire package is safety-critical. ────────────────────
backend/services/billing/**

# ── Billing HTTP routes: Lemon + Polar webhooks, checkout, account
#    (/me + customer-portal), and owner-only readiness diagnostics. ───────
backend/routes/v2_billing.py
backend/routes/v2_billing_polar.py
backend/routes/v2_billing_checkout.py
backend/routes/v2_billing_account.py
backend/routes/v2_admin_billing.py

# ── Shared runtime config that holds provider selection + Polar/Lemon
#    validation and the Polar production cutover fail-closed logic. This is
#    a shared file; billing-relevant edits here are high-risk and must be
#    declared + owner-reviewed. ───────────────────────────────────────────
backend/core/config.py

# ── Billing behavior tests: they encode webhook / subscription /
#    entitlement / checkout expectations; a change here can quietly weaken
#    the safety net. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
backend/tests/test_billing_*.py

# ── Billing frontend: the provider-neutral API client, the checkout hook,
#    and the checkout return page (which must never grant access from a
#    redirect alone). ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
src/lib/billingApi.ts
src/lib/billingApi.test.ts
src/hooks/useCheckout.ts
src/pages/BillingReturn.tsx

# ── Billing environment examples + migration documentation. `.env.example`
#    holds names + placeholders only; the migration doc encodes the cutover
#    and webhook/event contract. ────────────────────────────────────────
docs/billing/**

# ── The protection policy itself. Changing the guard, the path list, the
#    owners map, or the policy doc weakens the control, so it also requires
#    the declaration + owner review. ───────────────────────────────────────
.github/protected-billing-paths.txt
.github/workflows/protected-billing-surface.yml
.github/CODEOWNERS
docs/engineering/PROTECTED_BILLING_SURFACE.md
